itemUsage.en: Ines's past is unimportant. Anyway, she wishes to say, 'It's been a while.'
itemUsage.zh: 伊内丝的过往身份并不重要。总之，她想说好久不见。

itemDesc.en: Always keep an eye on the shadow beneath you. Don't let it expose what's on your mind.
itemDesc.zh: 时刻低头注意自己的影子，别让它暴露你所有的心思。

description.en:
<@ba.rem>The first deployment costs 0 DP, places a Shadow Sentry on the field, and immediately refreshes Redeployment Time</>
After deployment, <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> ATK, immediately retrieves the Shadow Sentry, and deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to up to <@ba.vup>{max_target}</> enemies it passes through; while active, gains <@ba.vup>{cost}</> DP for each attack on an enemy
description.zh: <@ba.rem>首次部署时不消耗部署费用，放置一个影哨后离场并立刻刷新再部署时间</>\n部署后攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，立刻收回影哨对穿过的最多<@ba.vup>{max_target}</>名敌人造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害，技能期间每对一个敌人造成伤害就获得<@ba.vup>{cost}</>点部署费用

description.en:
Only three in the afternoon, and the sunlight has already stopped shining on the little store. In the gloom, Ines sweeps the last of the broken glass down the steps, then heads back into the shop to sit down. The general store is located halfway up a slope. Anyone who passes by will see it and its bizarre one-and-a-half-step stairs.
The place was chosen by Hoederer, who said it was prime real estate and that she'd make her money back quick, but she originally just wanted to go find a container out in the sheds that didn't leak, dump her 'goods' inside, and collect the money at the door, like back in the Scar Market days. But she didn't argue. The war was over, for now, and the people returning to Kazdel should also return to their former lives. A proper place to buy things was only the first step.
'You put the curtain away?' Hoederer had tried to lift it out of habit as he walked in.
A finger extends out of the shadows, pointing at the ornamental fin bowl on the counter. Multicolored beads from the curtain line its bottom, but there is no fin there, nor any water.
'...It's fine. As long as the beads are still here, I can string them back together.'
The finger retracts back into the shadows. Hoederer walks to the shelves, picking up the fallen Originium bomb samples one by one and placing them back into their box, then moves on to tidying up the knives. Everything else, he reorganizes by how dangerous they are and where they were imported from. Once done, he gives it all a once-over. A damp, sticky liquid remains on the floor, the result of someone giving up trying to clean it halfway through.
The man walks back to the counter and pulls out a very fortunate three-legged stool to sit on. From his pockets, he takes out a knife and a piece of wood the size of his hand. By the time Ines finally pulls herself out of her contemplation, he has carved it into an oval.
'What're you doing?'
'I call it the 'W-tato'. Doesn't it look like her?'
'Not in the slightest. And you know that's wood, right?'
'Right, because real potatoes should be for eating.'
'And real knives should be for killing.'
'Was that what you were thinking when you used that real knife of yours to carve your horns?'
Ines sinks back into silence. Hoederer blows away the wood shavings. To his surprise, there is a faint glimmer accompanying them as they flutter through the air.
'Alright, change of topic. What happened earlier?'
'Some people decided this place was their safehouse and storeroom. I corrected them, that's all.'
'And that liquid on the ground...?'
'Soda.'
'Did they repay you?'
The woman gives him a look that all but says 'Are you serious?'. Hoederer puts down the W-tato and gropes around in the drawer, pulling out the account book from its depths.
'Ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, ten thousands... That's a lot of zeros, Ines. You sure you wrote this down right?'
'Look where the decimal point is.'
'......
'I'll be honest, I don't think you should be keeping your accounts like this.'
'The numbers aren't wrong.'
'No, that's not... fine. At least the bowl didn't break, right? And no blood was shed. I think you can move the decimal point forward a spot—'
'It was just a bunch of kids who got duped into coming here. They couldn't even tell the bombs from the soda bottles. They just grab the box and ran.
'I tripped them up, but one of them knocked over a shelf, giving the other two a chance to escape.'
'You went easy on them.'
'I was busy saving the fin and its bowl.'
'You can always buy another fin... Going to open up shop tomorrow?'
Ines steps out of the darkness onto the damp spot, looking all around her.
'Of course, why wouldn't I?
'The shop's already here.'
description.zh:
下午三点，阳光就已经照不进小店。伊内丝在昏暗里把最后一点玻璃碎片扫下台阶，走回店铺最深处坐下。这间杂货店位于一道斜坡的中间地带，只要有人路过，就会看见它和它怪异的一级半台阶。
位置是赫德雷选的，声称是黄金地段，能很快回本，但伊内丝本来只想在棚屋区找一个不漏水的集装箱，把那些“货”都倒进去，然后坐在门口收钱，就像疤痕商场。不过她没有争辩，战争暂时结束了，所有回到卡兹戴尔的人也都应该回到生活中去，这是第一步。
“门帘怎么收起来了？”赫德雷从门口走进来时习惯性地抬手掀了一下。
伊内丝没有说话，一节手指从黑暗里伸出来，戳向收银台上的观赏鳞水缸。原本是门帘的五彩珠子都在里面，但鳞不见了，水也没有了。
“……没事。珠子还在就行，我串得起来。”
于是伸出来的手指也收了回去。赫德雷走到货架旁边，把掉到地上的源石炸弹样品一个一个捡起来放回箱子里，摆好刀具，并将剩下的东西按照危险程度和进口地区重新排列。结束之后他环视一圈，地上残留的液体潮湿而黏稠，是有人曾经努力清理又半途放弃的结果。
男人于是回到收银台附近，抽出一个幸运的三脚凳坐下，从口袋里摸出小刀和半块巴掌大的木头。等伊内丝终于从沉思中抽离，他手里的木头已经变成了椭圆形。
“你在做什么？”
“土豆W。不像吗？”
“可以说毫无关系。而且你用的是木头。”
“对，因为真的土豆是用来吃的。”
“真的刀也是用来杀人的。”
“当初，你用真刀一遍遍磨自己的角时，也是这么想的吗？”
伊内丝再度沉默。赫德雷把木屑吹开，尘灰扑到空气中，竟然像在微微闪烁。
“好吧，不说这个。今天又发生什么了？”
“有人把这里当成了安全屋和补给室，我纠正了他们，就这样。”
“那地上的液体……?”
“是汽水。”
“他们赔钱了吗？”
女人刺过去一个“废话”的眼神。赫德雷放下“土豆W”，从抽屉里摸出账本来。
“个、十、百、千、万……伊内丝，这上面有很多零，你确定没写错吗？”
“你再看一眼小数点在哪里。”
“……
“我觉得你不能再这样记账了，说真的。”
“我的方法没错。”
“不……好吧。那至少今天水缸没有被打破，是不是？而且也没有发生流血冲突，你可以把小数点往前挪一位——”
“那只是一群小孩，被骗过来，结果连源石炸弹和汽水都分不清，拿了箱子就跑。
“我把他们绊倒在地上，其中一个把货架拽下来，给剩下两个创造了逃跑的机会。”
“你放水了。”
“我在抢救那条鳞和它的水缸。”
“鳞还可以再买……明天还开店吗？”
伊内丝从黑暗里站起来，走到水渍所在的位置，环视四周。
“当然要开，为什么不？
“店已经在这里了。”
